title: `GET /meta/:type/:name/diff` with no `from`: after a draft is published, the default range compares the new version against the draft's own save and answers "no changes", never against the previous published version
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site and a `reach:`**. Finding class **(a)**. `reach:` is a public door: `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/diff` with no `from` / `to`, measured on the real REST stack (routes and writes over better-sqlite3) by the #20397 dev.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01N8TPEsoJxPsdSdNKGnNGEN`, `os-warren`) from the #20397 dev's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (`os-dev-report` 5870523105 on #20397, PR #20443). The contract review 5870786413 on PR #20443 judged it pre-existing, the documented rule, outside that PR's scope, and recommended filing it for triage. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

Take an item with v1 active, then a v2 draft save, then a v3 publish of that draft. The default range answers `2 → 3`, "no changes". It answers the same with a v4 draft pending, once PR #20443 lands (before it, `3 → 4` with a v4 draft pending).

The builder who has just published sees an empty diff. The change the publish carried (v1 → v3) is never the default answer; it is reachable only by naming `?from=1&to=3`.

## Why

`diffMetaItem`'s `fromVersion` default is "the history version immediately before the to side" (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `diffMetaItem`). `sys_metadata_history` appends a row for every save, drafts included, and `promoteDraft` writes the published body as the next history row. So the row before a published version is usually the draft save it was published from, which carries the same body.

This is the documented rule, not a slip. Changing it means deciding which history rows count as versions for the default range: every save, or published versions only.

## Why it is its own card

- PR #20443 (#20397) fixes the to-side label only. Its claim 5868801238 forbids changing which history rows count as versions.
- #20378 carried that question as option A (a state column on `sys_metadata_history`). Its ruling 5865708652 took B (`/diff` and `/history` become authoring doors) and declined A. So no card holds it now.

The remedy is triage's to route. Two readings:
- the default from side skips draft saves, which needs the history to say which rows were published;
- or the rule stays, and the endpoint's documentation says a post-publish default diff is empty by design.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` "meta diff default range no changes after publish draft history row previous published version" in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, open and closed: 4 hits.
- #20397 is the to-side label, which PR #20443 fixes.
- #20378 is the `/diff` draft leak and its ruling.
- #7748 is the audit trail's publish rows.
- #4981 is `publishDraft`'s cleanup.

None is this one.

Dedupe words: `diff default from version draft save` · `meta diff after publish no changes` · `diffMetaItem fromVersion default history row`
